CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_job_quick_read(p_job_id text, p_formatter text, p_token uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 select public.claim_job_quick_read_auto(p_job_id,p_formatter,p_token,'source-limits-v1')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.quick_read_auto_candidates()
 RETURNS TABLE(id text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 select a.job_id from public.quick_read_auto_queue a
 join public.jobs j on j.id=a.job_id::bigint
 left join public.job_quick_reads q on q.job_id=a.job_id
 where exists(select 1 from public.quick_read_auto_control c where c.id and c.enabled
   and c.activated_at is not null and a.inserted_at>=c.activated_at)
 and exists(select 1 from public.quick_read_rollout_stop r where r.id and r.enabled and (r.cooldown_until is null or r.cooldown_until<=now()))
 and a.state in ('pending','running') and a.attempts<3 and a.next_attempt_at<=now()
 and j.status='active' and j.philippines_eligible is true
 and exists(select 1 from public.public_jobs v where v.id=j.id)
 and length(btrim(j.description))>=100 and length(j.description)<=40000
 and (q.job_id is null or a.recovery or a.attempts>0 and q.updated_at<=a.updated_at)
 order by a.next_attempt_at,a.inserted_at,a.job_id limit 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.quick_read_enqueue_missing()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare n integer;
begin
 perform 1 from public.quick_read_control where id for update;
 if not exists(select 1 from public.quick_read_rollout_stop where id and ongoing and enabled) then return 0; end if;
 insert into public.quick_read_auto_queue(job_id,recovery,target_source_hash)
 select j.id::text,true,encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(j.description,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
 from public.public_jobs j
 left join public.job_quick_reads q on q.job_id=j.id::text
 left join public.quick_read_auto_queue a on a.job_id=j.id::text
 where length(btrim(j.description)) between 100 and 40000
   and not coalesce(q.status='ready' and q.schema_version=2 and q.formatter_version='source-organizer-v2'
     and q.source_hash=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(j.description,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),false)
   and not coalesce(q.status='running' and q.lease_until>now(),false)
   and not coalesce(q.status='failed' and q.error_code in ('unsupported_source','unsafe_source')
     and q.source_hash=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(j.description,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),false)
   and (a.job_id is null or a.target_source_hash is distinct from encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(j.description,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'))
 order by j.id limit 500
 on conflict(job_id) do update set recovery=true,target_source_hash=excluded.target_source_hash,state='pending',attempts=0,
 next_attempt_at=now(),claim_token=null,last_status='source_backfill',updated_at=now();
 get diagnostics n=row_count;
 return n;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION veeays_admin.member_active()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from auth.users u join auth.sessions s on s.user_id=u.id
  where u.id=auth.uid() and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=now())
   and s.id::text=current_setting('request.jwt.claims',true)::jsonb->>'session_id'
   and (s.not_after is null or s.not_after>now()));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.veeays_member_active()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$select veeays_admin.member_active()$function$
